append.detail:
CLOSED 2026-09-29 (ADR-1658). RE-TESTED FIRST (ADR-1082): no acceptable-use policy for Space email existed anywhere in the tree. The enable card's header comment said "counsel-gated AUP is deferred" and lib/spaces/email.ts listed "AUP/DPA legal copy" as out of scope; the only rules an owner agrees to are the Terms and the one checkbox on the Turn on email card. WHAT SHIPPED: app/space-email-policy/page.tsx, a plain-language draft beside app/terms and app/privacy, built the same way (FocusTemplate, the same draft banner shape). It is marked DRAFT, not in force, not legal advice, and not reviewed; robots noindex/nofollow; absent from app/sitemap.ts; linked from nowhere. The Turn on email card is unchanged for the owner (its checkbox and copy are untouched); only its header comment now names the draft and says why it is not linked. GROUNDED IN THE CODE, rule by rule: who sends (canEditProfile plus the per-Space email function, default minimum role admin, lib/spaces/functions.ts; email off until the spaces.email_enabled kill switch is turned on with the acknowledgment); who receives (canEmailContact: a marketing send needs consent_state subscribed in that Space; the doors that write subscribed are a join, a contact-form opt-in tick, a lead magnet, an unlocked QR offer and an accepted warm intro, lib/crm/lead-capture.ts; an import lands unknown, lib/crm/import/commit.ts; the one relaxed lane is an event host mailing that event's own guests with topic events, consentPurposeForLane); how it goes out (the shared Resend sender with the Space's name as display name, no Reply-To, RFC 8058 one-click header plus footer link, open pixel and click redirect); limits (DAILY_SEND_CAP 500 a day UTC on every plan, the plan's monthly space_email allowance, skipped recipients count against neither); unsubscribes (per-Space suppression, per-topic mute, the Space's suppression list is read-only); bounces and complaints (the Resend webhook suppresses a hard bounce or complaint globally and for the Space; the Email panel warns over 0.1% complaints); turning email off (the same kill switch; platform staff hold Space admin capability, and it stops scheduled sends and sequences too, because the system send path re-checks it). The prohibited-content list, the appeal address and the notice-by-email line are policy, not code, and the draft says the list is for review. OPEN QUESTIONS FOR COUNSEL are the last section of the page (eleven: sender of record and controller or processor; whose physical address, since the plain composer and sequences carry none; replies to a no-reply sender; the event host exception under CAN-SPAM, CASL and PECR; a join as consent; a complaint stopping every Space; enforcement with no automatic threshold and Space suspension not stopping email; the prohibited list for a wellness community; open and click tracking consent; acceptance by name with a date; the appeal reply time). FOUND IN PASSING, NOT FIXED HERE (one row per PR): suspending a Space (spaces.status suspended, setSpaceStatus) does not stop its email, because deliverSpaceCampaign never reads the status; and the plain campaign composer (lib/spaces/campaigns.ts renderCampaignHtml) and the drip runner footer carry no postal address, while the block editor's footer carries Frequency Labs Holdings' address. OWN-085 now points at the draft and stays with the owner for counsel review. TESTS: app/space-email-policy/page.test.tsx (noindex, not in the sitemap, linked from nowhere, banner first, questions present, no em dash, and the cap, the 0.1% line, the admin default and the import consent state each read from the module that enforces them).

AMENDED 2026-09-30 by LIVE-729 (ADR-1673). The owner ruled on OWN-085 "Ship without counsel review", so the draft is now the live policy: indexed, in the sitemap, dated September 30, 2026, linked from the Turn on email card and the Terms, with the draft banner, the questions for counsel and the appeal placeholder gone. This row's probe asserted the hidden-draft state and is narrowed to what LIVE-707 built and still holds (the page and its rule sections, no em or en dash, the daily cap and the complaint line read from the code). LIVE-729 carries the live-state arms.
